items.source: Get the Field annotated with @BeanOverride.
items.translation: 获取带有@BeanOverride注解的 Field。

items.source: Create a bean override instance for an existing BeanDefinition or an existing singleton bean, based on the metadata in this BeanOverrideHandler.
items.translation: 为现有的 BeanDefinition 或现有单例 bean 创建一个 bean 覆盖实例，具体依据此 BeanOverrideHandler 中的元数据。

items.source: Get the bean name to override, or null to look for a single matching bean of type getBeanType().
items.translation: 获取要覆盖的 Bean 名称，或为 `null` 以查找与类型 getBeanType() 匹配的唯一 Bean。

items.source: Get the BeanOverrideStrategy for this BeanOverrideHandler, which influences how and when the bean override instance should be created.
items.translation: 获取此BeanOverrideHandler的BeanOverrideStrategy，它会影响 Bean 覆盖实例的创建方式和时机。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.2.6, in favor of BeanOverrideHandler(Field, ResolvableType, String, String, BeanOverrideStrategy)
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.2.6 起，推荐使用 BeanOverrideHandler(Field, ResolvableType, String, String, BeanOverrideStrategy)

items.source: Get the bean type to override.
items.translation: 获取要覆盖的 bean 的type。

items.source: field - the Field annotated with @BeanOverride, or null if @BeanOverride was declared at the type level
items.translation: field - 带有Field注解的@BeanOverride，或者如果@BeanOverride在类型级别声明则为null

items.source: strategy - the BeanOverrideStrategy to use
items.translation: strategy - 要使用的BeanOverrideStrategy

items.source: beanType - the type of bean to override
items.translation: beanType - 要覆盖的 bean 的类型

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean to override, or null to look for a single matching bean by type
items.translation: beanName - 要覆盖的 Bean 的名称，或为 null 以通过类型查找单个匹配的 Bean

items.source: WARNING: Implementations are used as a cache key and must implement proper equals() and hashCode() methods based on the unique set of metadata used to identify the bean to override. Overridden equals() and hashCode() methods should also delegate to the super implementations in this class in order to support the basic metadata used by all bean overrides. In addition, it is recommended that implementations override toString() to include all relevant metadata in order to enhance diagnostics.
items.translation: 警告：实现类用作缓存键，必须基于用于标识要覆盖的 Bean 的唯一元数据集合，实现正确的equals()和hashCode()方法。覆盖的equals()和hashCode()方法还应委托到此类的super实现，以支持所有 Bean 覆盖所需的基本元数据。此外，建议实现类覆盖toString()，包含所有相关元数据，以增强诊断功能。

items.source: When wrapping a bean created by a FactoryBean, the object created by the FactoryBean will be wrapped, not the FactoryBean itself.
items.translation: 当包装由FactoryBean创建的 bean 时，被包装的是FactoryBean创建的对象，而不是FactoryBean本身。

items.source: To provide proper support for @ContextHierarchy, invoke BeanOverrideHandler(Field, ResolvableType, String, String, BeanOverrideStrategy) instead.
items.translation: 为正确支持 @ContextHierarchy， 请改用 BeanOverrideHandler(Field, ResolvableType, String, String, BeanOverrideStrategy)。

items.source: When replacing a bean created by a FactoryBean, the FactoryBean itself will be replaced with a singleton bean corresponding to bean override instance created by the handler.
items.translation: 当替换由 FactoryBean 创建的 Bean 时，FactoryBean 本身将被替换为对应于处理器创建的 Bean 覆盖实例的单例 Bean。

items.source: Concrete implementations of BeanOverrideHandler can store additional metadata to use during override instance creation — for example, based on further processing of the annotation, the annotated field, or the annotated class.
items.translation: `BeanOverrideHandler` 的具体实现可以存储额外的元数据，以便在创建覆盖实例时使用——例如，基于对注解、被注解字段或被注解类的进一步处理。

items.source: This method does not search the enclosing class hierarchy and does not search for @BeanOverride declarations on classes or interfaces.
items.translation: 此方法不搜索封闭类层次结构，也不在类或接口上搜索 `@BeanOverride` 声明。

items.source: If a context name is configured for this handler, it must match a name configured via @ContextConfiguration(name=...).
items.translation: 如果为此处理器配置了上下文名称，它必须与通过 `@ContextConfiguration(name=...)` 配置的名称匹配。

items.source:
When replacing a non-singleton bean, the non-singleton bean will be replaced
with a singleton bean corresponding to bean override instance created by the
handler, and the corresponding bean definition will be converted to a singleton.
Consequently, if a handler overrides a prototype or custom scoped bean, the
overridden bean will be treated as a singleton.
items.translation: 在替换非单例 Bean 时，该非单例 Bean 将被替换为由处理器创建的 Bean 覆盖实例所对应的单例 Bean，并且相应的 Bean 定义将转换为单例。因此，如果处理器覆盖了原型或自定义作用域的 Bean，则被覆盖的 Bean 将被视为单例。

items.source:
An empty string indicates that this handler should be applied to all
application contexts.
items.translation: 空字符串表示此处理器应应用于所有应用程序上下文。

items.source:
The default implementation does not track the supplied instance, but
this can be overridden in subclasses as appropriate.
items.translation: 默认实现不跟踪提供的实例，但可以在子类中根据需要覆盖此行为。

items.source: Process the given testClass and build the corresponding BeanOverrideHandler list derived from @BeanOverride fields in the test class and its type hierarchy.
items.translation: 处理给定的 `testClass` 并构建相应的 `BeanOverrideHandler` 列表，该列表源自测试类及其类型层次结构中的 @BeanOverride 字段。

items.source: Construct a new BeanOverrideHandler from the supplied values.
items.translation: 从提供的值构建一个新的BeanOverrideHandler。

items.source: existingBeanDefinition - an existing bean definition for the supplied bean name, or null if not available or not relevant
items.translation: existingBeanDefinition - 为提供的 bean 名称已存在的 bean 定义，或者如果不可用或不相关则为 null

items.source: existingBeanInstance - an existing instance for the supplied bean name for wrapping purposes, or null if not available or not relevant
items.translation: existingBeanInstance - 用于包装目的的已提供的 Bean 名称的现有实例，或者如果不可用或不相关则为 null

items.source: contextName - the name of the context hierarchy level in which the handler should be applied, or an empty string to indicate that the handler should be applied to all application contexts within a context hierarchy
items.translation: `contextName` - 应应用处理器的上下文层次结构级别的名称，或为空字符串以指示处理器应应用于上下文层次结构中的所有应用程序上下文。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean being overridden
items.translation: beanName - 被覆盖的 Bean 的名称

items.source: override - the bean override instance to track
items.translation: override - 要跟踪的 Bean 覆盖实例

items.source: singletonBeanRegistry - a registry in which this handler can store tracking state in the form of a singleton bean
items.translation: singletonBeanRegistry - 一个此处理器可以以单例 Bean 的形式存储跟踪状态的注册表

items.source: Simon Baslé, Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Simon Baslé, Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen

items.source: a list of bean override handlers
items.translation: bean 覆盖处理器列表

items.source: the instance with which to override the bean
items.translation: 用于覆盖 Bean 的实例

items.source: Singleton Semantics
items.translation: 单例语义

items.source: Track the supplied bean override instance that was created by this BeanOverrideHandler.
items.translation: 跟踪由此 BeanOverrideHandler 创建的 Bean 覆盖实例。

items.source:
Get the name of the context hierarchy level in which this handler should
be applied.
items.translation: 获取此应用作用范围的上下文层次结构级别的名称。

items.source: equals in class Object
items.translation: `equals` 在类 `Object` 中

items.source: hashCode in class Object
items.translation: `hashCode` 在类 `Object` 中

items.source: toString in class Object
items.translation: `toString` 在类 `Object` 中

items.source: testClass - the test class to process
items.translation: testClass - 要处理的测试类
